notes.title: TOSS!🍌 Multiplayer update FREE for all players.
notes.content:
It's time to go Bananas together with the FREE content update for the VR Platformer TOSS!🍌. The update is available free for all players. Today's update will introduce 3-player multiplayer and all-new content called B-sides.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
By far the most requested feature has been:
[i]"I would like to play TOSS!🍌 with my friends"
"This game would be EVEN better with multiplayer"
"The game is perfect, it just needs multiplayer!"[/i]

We have listened and worked hard to enable the bananas TOSS!🍌 experience to be shared along with your friends. And you are correct... IT IS AWESOME!
Experience the full adventure, all 90+ levels, together with up to 3 other players! Create a closed room for you and your buddies or join a public room to find new friendships. Jump online and experience the world of TOSS!🍌like never before!

Cheer each other on while you race, chase, or simply free-roam the cloudscape levels together. Multiplayer allows you to play YOUR way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/3d52c3b9830bdf2bd905a3f68e3a29966abffb8e.jpg[/img]

[h2]TOSS!🍌 B-Sides - The ultimate platformer bananza![/h2]
Tossers, brace yourselves, for our latest content update, B-Sides, is here to catapult you into a whole new dimension. This freshly new update includes 3 hidden B-Side areas to the game, adding entirely new levels, rewards and whacky modifiers!
Scattered around the game are 3 sentient bananas that challenge you to grab them. If you find them – they will put you to the test!

🟡 [b]B-Side 01 -[/b] The Tiny Testing Ground: Embark on a quest, where everything gets a bit out of scale. 
🟡[b] B-Side 02 -[/b] Jumbo Jungle: Go hard or go home, it is not just your hands that are getting big – The challenge is supersized too!
🟡 [b]B-Side 03 [/b]- Stilts Showdown: Get ready to elevate your game to new heights, or is it… elongate – this one is quite literal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/e29b9f13a7e9ac59b939acbfb455a559126a9da5.jpg[/img]

But are you ready?! These B-Sides are no picnic! They're designed for the cream of the crop, the true black belts. Think you've got what it takes?
Toss, twist, and triumph. Dare the TOSS!🍌 B-Sides now and show the world that you're not just a tosser but a tossing virtuoso! 🌟🍌

notes.title: Unleash your inner monkey: TOSS!🍌 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QcXWv2auBpQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]TOSS IS OUT NOW![/b][/h2]

TOSS!🍌 has been with us for close to five years, and it's difficult to put into words just how excited we are to finally share it with all of you.

The sheer love and effort we've poured into making TOSS!🍌 is something we will remember as part of this amazing time, and the tons of feedback and encouragement we have gotten from you - the awesome players - is what has been pushing us.

We are super proud of what we've accomplished, and thrilled to continue our journey on TOSS!🍌 together with you!

[h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT[/b][/h3]

Swing and toss yourself freely across spacey jungle-gym playgrounds, as an acrobatic monkey, in this bananas VR platformer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/63b9cc960ff7d4201aa1299f0c7b997d02b9f3da.png[/img]

You've crash landed on a cloud planet and will need to collect parts to repair your ship as you launch yourself around 75+ playground levels in 9 vibrant cloudscape biomes and rank-up to become a TOSS!🍌 master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/9a8747638a93f76034cfd6c21c764b6d4f05a0bd.png[/img]

This VR game uniquely captures the agility, timing and gamer skill required to play the beloved platformer classics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/dec52a3ce7cbe9fba8a579781126c12cf7c43146.png[/img]


🐵 [b]PARKOUR ACTION:[/b] Soar and launch yourselves through the air, grab hold of trees, pipes, and walls.

🔥 [b]CHALLENGES:[/b] Try to race against the clock, with Time Attack; find as many bananas as possible or master as few grabs as possible in each round.

🍌 [b]SOCIAL COMPETITION:[/b] Compete against each other by time and rank, and follow your friends' leaderboard ghosts.

🥋 [b]MASTERY & MODIFIERS:[/b] Unlock modifiers like Zero Gravity and Double Toss by becoming a TOSS!🍌 master!

[h3][b]GRAB IT NOW[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/

-- Albin, Simon, Eddie & Toss

notes.title: 1 Week Till We Are Pressing The Launch Button!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello monkeys![/h2]

Time is closing in and we are getting real close to the official release day for TOSS!🍌

We are really looking forward to watching returning players to experience the full version of the game as well as newcomers to the title who are leaping into the Spacey jungle gym playgrounds, high above the clouds, for the very first time. It will be a healthy mix between new players and those who have some experience in their backpack from playing during the alpha and beta versions of the game.

Expect to be drawn into a rich and vibrant world where you will learn how to move (and behave like a monkey) in true platformer fashion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/4ef30194e859f7993f7167d811cfbf13b5c56e62.png[/img]

[u]Dare the obstacle course playgrounds[/u] by dodging [b]rocket-powered boxing gloves[/b], avoid [b]lasers[/b], bounce on [b]trampolines [/b]and much more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/b4a0f4ab029e3fc232286411c44ce9831a3b867c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/ea74e84219d790e62ff415674756ec3c728d0a3f.gif[/img]

[u]Find the ship pieces[/u] required to repair your rocketship, collect the hard to reach bananas and complete the daring challenges on your way through the story. 

And remember - you can always back-peddle to previous levels if you didn’t complete all of the challenges on your first run. Completing all of them might grant you a flashy award to show off to your friends!

For those striving to go [b]toe to toe[/b] with other players, they can challenge the ghostly trails of other players on every level of the game. May it be of your friends, experienced players, newcomers, or perhaps even one of the developers - if you can catch up! For those looking for a more competitive segment of the game, this is a feature that will keep your desires occupied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/00942d8c892abd7352a56556646c02eaefdf138d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/43ec49e830c35c8cf02cdbd4793e1403c79d1c50.gif[/img]

With that said, we cannot wait to see you swinging and tossing!

September 7th is just around the corner.

notes.title: IT'S TIME TO MEET TOSS! 🙊🙉🙈
notes.content:
It’s been another wild week for TOSS!🍌 

Last week our swingin' friend, Toss, took over all socials, sharing bananas gameplay and showcasing some of the mesmerizing biomes to be found in this world! And now... It's time for you to meet Toss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/4ef30194e859f7993f7167d811cfbf13b5c56e62.png[/img]

Toss isn't your average simian, they are a true astro-monkey.

Stranded on a cloudplanet after their rocketship crash-landed, they must use all their acrobatic skill from space-training to toss themselves around the cloudscape playgrounds, gathering all of their lost bananas and finding the pieces of their broken ship to return home.

Luckily they won't have to do it all alone, a trusty A.I. Bot native to this strange planet will guide the way!


September 7th is only 6 weeks away, so make sure to stay tuned to our socials to get more content from TOSS!🍌 [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tossvr]TikTok [/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/TossVR]Twitter [/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/TossVR/]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: 2022 Summer Developer Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello[/b] fellow Apes! 🐵

Together with the summer heat comes a developer update!
There's mostly just the one question on everyone's mind right now. Today, we'd like to do our best to address the [strike]elephant[/strike] gorilla in the room.

[b]Why can't I play TOSS!🍌 yet?[/b]

[b](1)[/b] As some of you are aware, we are a 3-person company as well as an independent studio. As much as we love to devote ourselves to the development we also need to feed our mouths, pay for all the expenses of running a studio & take care of the overhead tasks outside of actual game production. We are a tiny - but passionate.

[b](2)[/b] We are still growing as both developers & as a company. This will be Agera Games' first commercial release and a large part of the work we're doing right now has to do with establishing a solid foundation for more reliable, quicker and bigger productions. This includes having a lot of meetings, waiting for big wheels to turn slowly and hoping for favorable outcomes. In other words: It's not the most exciting part of the process but we believe that once we get over this hump, there's a fun and smooth ride ahead of us.

[b](3)[/b] The scope & quality of the game has improved and expanded from what we initially planned. With more and better content it also takes longer to finish milestones & make improvements to the game itself. This brings us to (4).

[b](4)[/b] We want to deliver a polished, smooth & impactful game. We are pouring all our knowledge & expertise into this for you to receive a game we as developers can be proud of and you as community to relish and be entertained by for hours!

With all this we appreciate our community's continued patience & support. We can't wait to eventually release the game and play it along with you all!

We're also very happy to share a little bit of the new content we made for you all. Enjoy and feel free to join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/mxy6tj5e][LINK][/url] to tell us what you think. 💛

notes.title: TOSS!🍌 v0.1.1
notes.content:
TOSS!🍌 v0.1.1
- Adjusted default finger curling to feel more realistic
- Made it easier to grab on to stuff (right now your hands can look kind of floaty because of this. We'll want to fix that in the future.)
- Physics updates now target your device refresh rate. Please let us know if you're experiencing any physics problems or lag after this update!
- Hopefully made it impossible for your hands to go through something when you're trying to grab while moving very quickly. However, there may be a slight disconnect between where your real hand and your virtual hands are. We're working on fixing that, but figured this is better than just straight up missing grabs.
- Added extra Oculus Quest 2 controller fallback, which should make your in-game hands line up more correctly with those controllers
- If you started the game through SteamVR and you're using an Oculus device, the menu button might not have opened the in-game menu button before. Since Steam overrides the menu button with the SteamVR menu, you can now reach the menu through the secondary button on your controller.

This is not the 🍌-event update. Stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Community Challenge: THE BANANAS ARE LOOSE!🍌 (again)
notes.content:
[h1]TOSS!🍌 goes bananas[/h1]
📅 [i]Event begins 5 hours from posting (3 PM PST / midnight CET)[/i] ⏳
[list]
[*] Scattered across the TOSS!🍌 DEMO levels are ten (10) hidden bananas.
[*] Your objective is to work together as a community to find each and every one of them.
[*] However, only one banana is visible at a time. You can't find all of them right away.
[*] It's not until someone in the community has [b]posted proof of them reaching and grabbing the banana on our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url][/b] that the next banana will unlock. 
[/list]
Hi everyone, we're super glad you're enjoying the TOSS!🍌 DEMO. There's only 3 days left to play, and we would like to celebrate that with a fun community event! 🙉
[h1]How do we play?[/h1]
[olist]
[*] To participate in the event, start off by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url] and say hi to our amazing community 👋🐵
[*] We will be broadcasting the #demo-stream voice channel on Discord to Steam and Twitch during the event. You're very welcome to join the voice channel or use the #demo-stream-chat. [i]Remember to be excellent to each other or we will bring out the ban-hammer.[/i]
[*] Wait until the event begins, then update your game to make sure you're on the 🍌-version. Can't see the update? Try restarting Steam!
[*] Start exploring! The bananas could be just about anywhere, but they do follow two simple rules: they're never inside of a wall and they don't require any sort of glitching to get to.
[*] If you do find a banana, post some proof to the #demo-stream-chat channel or ask a developer to look at your stream on Discord!
[*] Well done, you just unlocked the next banana for the whole community!
[*] Wait for the devs to publish a new 🍌-version of the game, then update the game again to be able to see the next banana
[*] Keep going bananas! 🍌
[/olist]
[h1]What do we win?[/h1]
If the TOSS!🍌 community manages to find all of the hidden bananas, everyone who was part of the event will get an [b]EXCLUSIVE[/b] in-game prize unlocked when the full game is released. 
What could it be? 🐵

More importantly, you get to have a lot of fun playing and interacting with the TOSS!🍌 community!

[b]HAVE FUN!🍌[/b]

notes.title: Devlog - YOU made the Closed Alpha Weekend AWESOME!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/90f3203404c663a02aab30883cbb38d3ebfc92ac.png[/img]
[/url]
[h2]Devlog #1[/h2]
Hello everyone! TOSS!🍌 developers Simon & Albin here.

To start things off we would like to give a big thank you to everyone who played TOSS!🍌 in the Closed Alpha Weekend. Especially thanks for all the feedback you've been giving us on our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord community[/url] and through our feedback form! We have read through and discussed basically everything you've sent us, in order to get a grip on what to do next. It's been a blast and we can't wait to keep making TOSS!🍌 a better game in every way thanks to your feedback and ideas.

Never could we have guessed that there would be an astonishing [b]276 playtesters[/b] trying out our game. Each and every one of you is awesome, and the reason that TOSS!🍌 is blossoming into a wonderful community.

[h2]Public roadmap[/h2]
We noticed how much you like transparency, and we want to be open about how we are going to take your feedback and use it to improve TOSS!🍌. That's why we've made a public roadmap! On it, you can find issues, improvements & features based on the feedback we have received. Continuing to share the development process with you is gonna be so much fun.

For example, we will absolutely try our best to have equally finetuned support for the Vive, Index, Rift, Rift S and WMR next time we do playtesting. That includes [b]turning around using controller[/b], [b]menu button support on SteamVR[/b], [b]framerate independent tossing[/b], [b]comfortable gripping + hand positioning[/b] and more. We know how important supporting all platforms properly is thanks to your feedback! 🙈

We're also [b]fixing all the "yeet bugs"[/b] we can reproduce, looking at [b]being able to grab with two hands[/b], getting around to removing [b]glitching through walls[/b] and lots more. 🍌

So don't wait another minute - take a look at our brand new [b][url=https://trello.com/b/BdA7AUFP]public roadmap[/url][/b]!

We've tried addressing mostly everything we've heard from you, but if you don't see your idea or an issue you reported on there please do tell us. 

Note that there's no intended priority in the order the cards are placed on the board. We also do work on TOSS!🍌 that isn't reflected on this board, which includes everything from bookkeeping 😴 to super cool stuff we're not ready to tell you about yet (NO SPOILERS! 🙊).

[h2]Takeaways[/h2]
Some of the feedback you've given us doesn't really translate into a road map, but we're still taking it with us. That's why we're doing our first ever devlog - do you like it? Tell us if this is a format you enjoy and would want us to keep doing!

[h3]Level design[/h3]
There is a lot to say in regards of the level design principles of TOSS!🍌 as it is such a major element to the experience of gameplay next to the mechanics of movement. A bunch of you made some really on point remarks regarding the level design in particular - much appreciated! That together with the extensive amount of streams we’ve been watching as well as the analysis we could make from the measurable data in the feedback form has provided us with a lot insights. This will be added to our design guidelines and affect future level design. 

[list]
[*] More forgiving level design - Allow recovering from falls more often. Punishment should be getting a worse time, not having to restart.
[*] Smooth difficulty progression - Even out the difficulty spikes and allow for everyone to ease into the skill requirements
[*] More alternative routes - Allow for both easier, slow but safe routes & difficult, fast but risky routes
[*] Taking shortcuts should be interesting and exciting - Encourage using unique level mechanics in a skilled way to pull off skipping a part of the level
[*] More level mechanics - Everyone loves having more game mechanics to explore. Experimental levels were fun but admittedly difficult.
[*] Add more longer levels - It allows you to keep your moment up and stay in flow for longer.
[/list]

[h3]BREATHING MORE LIFE INTO TOSS!🍌[/h3]

One of the questions we've been asking ourselves this past week is "What is TOSS!🍌, except for it's gameplay?". The question isn't unfamiliar to us as our game design documents already detail a much richer world than what you've seen so far in the alpha, but all the feedback and suggestions we've been getting on this has made it more clear than ever how important this is to give TOSS!🍌 the life and nuance it deserves. 

[list]
[*] Improve sensation of being an ape - More interaction based audio
[*] Add more sky environments - Allow for a more varied aesthetic experience
[*] Fleshed out soundtrack - The music will of course be added to and improved upon, building onto the existing sensation of rhythm and movement
[*] Improved sound effects - Added to and improved sound for ambience and interacting with your environment
[*] Foliage - A lush greenery to add to the minimalistic design
[*] Birds - Not being alone in the world will definitely lively up the place 🕊
[*] Last, but definitely not least is the narrative - An overarching narrative goal will bring context and meaning to the gameplay of TOSS!🍌. We're very excited about this one!
[/list]


Thank you to everyone that has provided us with their creativity, patience and enthusiasm. We look forward to sharing this journey with you!

Simon & Albin

Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/]wishlist TOSS!🍌 now, right here on Steam[/url]. We would also love to have you in our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord community[/url] and tell us your thoughts on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/TossVR]/r/TossVR[/url]. ❤

notes.title: Community Challenge: TOSS!🍌 GOES BANANAS!
notes.content:
[h1]The bananas are loose![/h1]
[list]
[*] Scattered across the TOSS!🍌 Closed Alpha levels are ten (10) hidden bananas. 
[*] Your objective is to work together as a community to find each and every one of them. 
[*] However, only one banana is visible at a time. You can't find all of them right away.
[*] It's not until someone in the community has [b]screenshoted/recorded and posted footage of the currently visible banana to Twitter using the hashtag #TossVR[/b] that the next banana will unlock. 
[/list]

[h2]Steam Broadcast[/h2]
Joining us to broadcast the event is our good friend [url=https://www.twitch.tv/LarveyOfficial]LarveyOfficial[/url]. Watch it live through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270460/TOSS/]Steam Broadcast[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/AgeraGames]Twitch[/url] and in the [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]#toss-livestream channel on Discord[/url]. Larvey will start streaming half an hour before the event and keep going for as long as he feels like!

[h2]How do we play?[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Get on the [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url] and start strategizing (optional but fun)
[*] Wait until the event begins, then update your game to make sure you're on the 🍌-version. Can't see the update? Try restarting Steam!
[*] Start exploring! The bananas could be just about anywhere, but they do follow two simple rules: they're never inside of a wall and they don't require any sort of glitching to get to.
[*] If you do find a banana, go take a screenshot or record a video of it and post it to Twitter using the hashtag #TossVR
[*] Well done, you just unlocked the next banana for the whole community! 
[*] Wait for the devs to publish a new 🍌-version of the game, then update the game again to be able to see the next banana
[*] Keep going bananas! 🍌
[/olist]
The easiest way to stay updated on the event progress is through our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url], which you're very welcome to join. We're super friendly!

[h2]What do we get?[/h2]
If the TOSS!🍌 community manages to find all of the hidden bananas, we will unlock an extra level for the rest of the Closed Alpha Weekend (which ends at the same time as this event does). 

The level we've chosen (as seen below) has been requested a lot on our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url], and you will find it at the end of the EXPERIMENTAL chapter if you manage to unlock it. And don't worry, the speedrunning timer will still only be active from The First One to The Twisting One so this doesn't affect the speedrunning leaderboards. ⏲🐵

More importantly, you get to have a lot of fun playing and interacting with the TOSS!🍌 community! 

HAVE FUN!🍌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38317939/222cb5420da90fc52a6a91830044e1285206e7f6.png[/img]

[i]There is no secret 🍌-level[/i]

notes.title: SPEEDRUNNING CONTEST! Claim the world record and win a free copy of TOSS!🍌
notes.content:
[h1]TOSS!🍌 Speedrunning contest[/h1]
[h2]Prize[/h2]
The winner will get a free copy of TOSS!🍌 (the full game) when it releases! 🎉

[h2]When?[/h2]
CEST: 20:00 Saturday July 18th - 12:00 Sunday July 19th 
Pacific: 11 AM Saturday July 18th  - 3 AM July 19th 

[h2]Rules[/h2]
Record a video of yourself playing the game fair and square from the first level to the last. You'll have to record the game video on your PC, using version 0.0.3 of the game or later so you can get the built-in timer overlay. The new version of the game will be released at the same time the contest starts!

The timer starts on your first grab on the first level and stops when you press the green button on the last level. No level skipping allowed - if you use level select, the timer cancels and you will have to go back to the first level to reset it. 

You can play the levels in whichever way you want, as long as you [b]don't cheat[/b]. What counts as cheating? 

Here are some examples of [b]cheating[/b]:
[list]
[*] Glitching through walls 
[*] Moving your spawn point to get closer to the button
[*] Grabbing things that aren't supposed to be grabbable ([url=https://clips.twitch.tv/FaintPuzzledBadgerTBTacoRight]looking at you, Larvey![/url])
[/list]
These are some intended game mechanics that we encourage ([b]not cheating[/b]):
[list]
[*] Tossing yourself straight towards the button 
[*] Taking shortcuts by jumping across obstacles
[*] Using the momentum of moving objects
[/list]
Basically, [b]no glitching[/b]!

[h2]Submissions[/h2]
You can submit your speedruns either through Reddit or Twitter. If your video is too big to upload directly to one of those sites, you can first upload it to YouTube, Imgur or something similar. Make sure the video is public and please mention #TossVR.

If you're using Twitch to stream and record your speedrun, you can submit the VOD. Please timestamp your submission to the speedrun you would like us to look at.
[h3]Reddit[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Submit your video on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/TossVR/]/r/TossVR[/url] subreddit
[*] Title it something along the lines of "[07 : 23 : 015] TOSS!🍌 Speedrun" (replace with your actual time obviously)
[*] Add the “SPEEDRUN” flair after posting
[/olist] 
[h3]Twitter[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Post your video to Twitter, using the hashtag #TossVR and mentioning us at [url=https://twitter.com/TossVR]@TossVR[/url]
[*] Make sure to mention the time you got in your tweet
[/olist]
You're also very welcome to share your speedruns in the #toss-speedrun channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url]. That way we'll be sure not to miss the submission!

[h2]Good luck and try not hit a wall!🐵[/h2]
If you have any questions, get on the [url=https://discord.gg/MwnsNGz]Discord server[/url] and we'll sort things out. ❤
